headline: ARR ESS Leading Edge Private Ltd files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for SEL Manufacturing Company Limited
sum: ARR ESS Leading Edge Private Ltd has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in SEL Manufacturing Company Limited under SEBI Regulation 31(4), signalling a threshold cross (likely 25%+) triggering mandatory takeover disclosure requirements. No public announcement of consideration, offer price or merger terms has yet been made public.
detail: ARR ESS Leading Edge Private Ltd has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition in SEL Manufacturing. Under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers Regulations, 2011, any acquisition crossing 25% of shares (or 5% if already holding 25%+) triggers mandatory disclosure and, in most cases, a public announcement within 4 trading days. The specific shareholding percentage, consideration, and offer mechanics are not yet disclosed in public sources.
